text: I just downloaded this app and I've been using it for a long time. What I like: 1. The voice capture feature is very fast and amazing. 2. The interpretation of wasted words is also amazing: it filters out all the ums, uhs, and fillers. 3. It is super fast and very convenient. 4. It has that feature where you can shift from the voice recorder to a keyboard. Two suggestions for improvement: 1. Add an enter button on the keyboard section. When you switch to the keyboard, there is no enter
